intro.line: Innistrad, years after the Helvault opened. The angels are back, the moon is silver, and something is wrong.
The renewed howling of werewolves announced the end of the Cursemute—and the beginning of Avacyn's madness.
Sorin Markov has vanished. Jace Beleren has come looking for him, and finds strange stones everywhere he goes.
Every answer seems to lead to a more terrifying question.

finale.line: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.
The last titan is sealed inside the silver moon. Innistrad is broken, but it is still here.
It was easier than it should have been. Tamiyo is the only one who knows why, and she does not say.

villainFinale.line: All around Emrakul, life re-formed in her image.
Emrakul does not grant wishes. Desires simply align to her will.

portrait.card: Thing in the Ice // Awoken Horror
Arlinn Kord // Arlinn, Embraced by the Moon

battles.title: The Drownyard
battles.blurb: You find Jace Beleren on the Nephalian coast, following a trail of warped stones to a temple full of cultists.

cards.name: Daring Sleuth // Bearer of Overwhelming Truths
Thing in the Ice // Awoken Horror

scene.line: This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!
Amid the gibbering chorus that rose from the drownyard temple, Jace recognized a single word: "Emrakul."
Investigate: you make a Clue. Pay 2 and sacrifice it to draw a card. Crack them when you have spare mana.

villainScene.line: In times of madness, people cling to the familiar, monstrous though it may be.
A slow knock at midnight is best left unanswered.

hero.half: Crack a Clue at end of turn.

battles.title: Tamiyo's Journal
battles.blurb: Tamiyo, the moonfolk scholar, has been studying Innistrad for years. Avacyn's angels have stopped telling friend from foe.

scene.line: Entry 434: There's more to Avacyn's madness . . .
Is this what you found, Tamiyo?
Delirium: count the card types in your graveyard. Four or more and these cards grow stronger. Fill the graveyard on purpose.

villainScene.line: She now sees only Emrakul's visions.
If you refuse to see the light, then you will feel it.

hero.half: Get four types in the yard.

battles.title: Call the Bloodline
battles.blurb: Sorin needs an army, so he asks Olivia Voldaren for one. Thalia's heretic cathars are in the way, and none of them will bow.

cards.name: Heir of Falkenrath // Heir to the Night

scene.line: At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summoned the full might of her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.
As we muster for war, I have little patience for lethargy or recalcitrance.
Madness: when you discard a madness card, you may cast it for its madness cost instead. Discard on purpose, darling.

villainScene.line: Salvation will not be granted by the Lunarch Council. It must be earned—at the edge of a sword, if necessary.
We fight not for Avacyn, but for her ideals; not for the church, but for its people.

battles.title: Avacyn's Fall
battles.blurb: The truth comes out. Sorin sealed Nahiri in stone for a thousand years, and Nahiri has come back to take everything from him.

scene.line: Sorin, I'm going to take everything from you.
As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad. As I have wept, so will Sorin.
Transform: double-faced cards flip into their other side when something happens. Watch the angel. When she turns, she burns everything.

villainScene.line: You sought to anger me, Nahiri. Soon you will see how well you have succeeded.
Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

hero.half: Kill the angel before she turns.

villain.low: She is stronger than I remember...

battles.title: The Dronepack
battles.blurb: In Kessig, werewolves are turning into something worse. Arlinn Kord, a planeswalker who is also a werewolf, leads what is left of the pack.

cards.name: Arlinn Kord // Arlinn, Embraced by the Moon

scene.line: How can werewolves be considered abominations next to such creatures?
In the wake of Emrakul, some werewolves' human forms were lost forever.
Emerge: they sacrifice a creature to cast a horror for less. Every sacrifice makes something bigger. Kill the fodder first.

villainScene.line: The Somberwald has become a hunting ground for the Dronepack, the group of werewolves that have succumbed to the flesh-twisting power of Emrakul.
Emrakul does not grant wishes. Desires simply align to her will.

half.line: They sacrifice their own to make those things. Leave them nothing to sacrifice!

battles.title: Thraben Holds
battles.blurb: A tribute to Standard in 2016: white Humans against the Zombies that came from Gisa and Geralf's labs.

cards.name: Hanweir Militia Captain // Westvale Cult Leader

scene.line: If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least.
The uncorrupted rallied under Thalia's leadership and Sigarda's banner.
Skulk: a creature with skulk can't be blocked by creatures with greater power. Keep a small blocker home.

villainScene.line: Countless ghouls surged through Thraben's streets, and with them came the city's salvation.
Ludevic's laboratory is a veritable wonderland. I have never felt so inspired.

battles.title: The Spider Queen
battles.blurb: A tribute to Standard in summer 2016: white-blue Spirits with flash against green-black Delirium.

scene.line: Immune to the physical warping caused by Emrakul, geists proved to be some of humanity's most important allies.
There is always more to give.
Flash: these cards can be cast at instant speed. Pass with mana up and act on their turn.

villainScene.line: The old hermit would never say what he fed his mushrooms, and people learned not to ask.
When I was a child, we worried about picking the wrong mushrooms for the cook pot. Now we must worry about being picked ourselves.

battles.title: The Promised End
battles.blurb: Nahiri called Emrakul across the Blind Eternities. Now the last titan is on Innistrad, and the Gatewatch stands at Thraben.

scene.line: At Nahiri's call, Emrakul traversed the vast emptiness between the planes and arrived on Innistrad.
Gideon and Liliana may not have seen eye to eye, but that did not stop them from fighting side by side.
Escalate: their spells pay extra for each extra mode. Expect two or three effects at once. Hold the moon for the biggest thing.

villainScene.line: Hordes of Eldrazi and cultists swarmed over Thraben's defenses, and the members of the Gatewatch found themselves overrun.
An enigma as vexing as life itself.

hero.low: There is too much of it...
hero.half: Save the Moon for the biggest one.

half.line: The moon. Use the moon. I will explain later.

battles.title: Elder Deep-Fiend
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, the summer the horrors came from the sea.

archive.what: Green-blue decks, often with red, that sacrificed creatures to emerge Elder Deep-Fiend and Wretched Gryff, and later to cast Emrakul, the Promised End.
archive.why: Elder Deep-Fiend has flash. Emerged in your upkeep, it taps four of your permanents and leaves you a turn behind.
archive.beat: Play fast and keep their small creatures dead. Without fodder, emerge costs full price.
archive.after: Emrakul, the Promised End was banned in Standard in January 2017. Emrakul's card cannot be played by Forge's CPU, so this tribute plays its emerge creatures only.

deck.name: Emerge
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius.
If they sacrifice something in my upkeep, I lose a turn. Burn the fodder first.

villainScene.line: The tides have begun to ignore the moon.

after.line: Recorded: Emrakul, the Promised End banned in Standard, January 2017.
